title: Gelatin Functional
description: This datapack enhances your Minecraft world with new mechanics and features designed to improve gameplay, offering a more functional and immersive experience.
body:
# Install: I suggest you before you install, if you have installed this before, I suggest you delete the old files first and install this new one. Don't forget to run the command ```/function gf.delete``` # Features: ![settings_menu](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/30bfcc191fb296ab0542968421d3ac4441c8458a.png) you can run command ```/trigger gf.settings``` to setting (for now it can turn on/off) # Functional:
Digital Clock ![title_clk](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b589335ab7a6516b013bdd720747ba0d75efce43.png) ## How to use? You can [Sneak and Hold Clock] to activate, it will show you **Day**, **Time** and **Weather** ## Preview > ### Setting Menu: > ### Showcase:
Coordinate Compass ![title_cmp](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4091871f0d5211949eff6006cd865d401305fd7b.png) ## How to use? you can [Sneak and Hold Compass] to activate, it will show you **Dimension**, **X/Y/Z** and **Direction**
Portal Link ![title_ptl](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7c5113469f78da303492ed1e45d0dfb7ff92e107.png) ## How to use? you can [Sneak and Hold Obsidian] to activate, it will tell you what your coordinates in opposite dimension (between **Nether** and **Overworld**)
Cauldron Concrete ![culdron_concrete](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c740fdc994a3b0de1d702c739a7e3f7a63088f0b.png) You can drop your concrete powder into the water, it will take some time to transform to concrete block
Bees Info ![bees_info](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d816c323b5ef320c5a4dd377e3ef4324d7d01cc7_0.webp) you can [Sneak and Hold Shears] to activate. When you looking to the **Beehive** or **Bee Nest**, it will show how many bees in there and what level of honey
Lodestone Location ![lodestone_location](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/90c83458bb8fd953f32be8c9994ffda6a0a0028d_0.webp) you can [Sneak and Hold Lodestone Compass] to activate. **First**, It will check the destination and you are in the same dimension or not. **Second**, it will tell you how far away you are from your destination.
Seeds Sower you can [Sneak and Hold Any seeds] to activate, This function will auto plants with seed in your hand
# Feedback: Plase give me a feedback. I want to make it better to better
